# MetaHumotonic MCP public guide

The former static server list and shared credential instructions were retired on 2026-09-28. They did not establish current availability or grant access.

- Human guide: https://metahumotonic.com/mcp/
- Live discovery: https://metahumotonic.com/api/mcp/
- Live manifest: https://metahumotonic.com/api/mcp/manifest
- Live status: https://metahumotonic.com/api/mcp/status

Read each live response for its current registration and verification state. A listed tool still requires its own authorization. This document provides no credentials or connection recipe for private infrastructure.
